sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004 — Socio-Psychological Considerations in Building Design
sources.description: The building code addresses occupant well-being through minimum light, ventilation, and space standards that have socio-psychological implications.

sources.label: BP 344: Accessibility Law — Social Inclusion in Design
sources.description: Social inclusion requirements that address the needs of persons with disabilities in the built environment, affecting site planning decisions.
